name: Berberine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Singapore, first in 1978 — for liver harm, nerve and brain harm and blood problems

fda.text: : If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children. In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. Do not use if tamper evident seal is broken or missing. Store in a cool, dry place.

summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, estimated a medium score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M]. Historically, berberine was removed from the market in Singapore beginning in 1978 due to liver damage, harm to the nervous system, and harm to the blood [3]. Official warnings advise pregnant or breast-feeding individuals to consult a health professional before use and state to keep the product away from children [4]. Additionally, these warnings instruct people to get immediate medical help or call a Poison Control Center if an overdose occurs [4].
